consequence.statement: A new metrics.go log line is emitted for querier-to-ingester requests; no operational failure is stated.

original.statement: Loki adds a metrics.go log line for requests from querier to ingester.

decision.reason: [ev-833d940f9c35] lists this only as a feature: a new metrics.go log line for requests from the querier to the ingester. It says nothing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated, and no default changes. So "none" (informational, low severity) fits the evidence. Confidence is low because the changelog never says outright that there is no operational effect, such as extra log volume.
